canonical_name: DataVita DV4 Data Centre and Battery Storage, Lancaster Avenue, Chapelhall
summary: Pre-application data centre and battery storage proposal on Green Belt land at Lancaster Avenue, Chapelhall, forming part of DataVita/HFD's Lanarkshire AI Growth Zone programme (designated 29 January 2026 with CoreWeave as anchor partner; the 500MW figure is a zone-level claim, not this site's). A Proposal of Application Notice (25/01322/PAN) was lodged in December 2025, developer consultation events were held in May-June 2026, and an EIA screening request (26/00707/EIASCR) describing a c.100-124MW green data centre was determined 'EIA Not Required' on 19 June 2026. No planning application had been submitted as of 30 July 2026.
maturity_explanation: PAN 25/01322/PAN received 2025-12-17 (Comments issued 2026-01-19); statutory pre-application consultation events held 12 May, 2 June and 4 June 2026; EIA screening 26/00707/EIASCR determined not required 2026-06-19. No validated planning application located on the PlanIt mirror of the council portal as of 2026-07-30.
anticipated_operational_date: UK Government FoI response (per APRS): 'DV4 will be driven by Scottish Power connections timescales which we expect to be brought forward to 2027'

latest_development.headline: North Lanarkshire Council determined EIA is not required for the proposed DV4 data centre (26/00707/EIASCR); screening opinion published 20 July 2026 after campaign requests

unknowns: Named applicant on the PAN/screening (portal shows 'See source'; agent address 111 McDonald Road, Edinburgh; SPV DataVita DV4 Ltd exists but its role on the applications is unconfirmed)
